title: Papyrus build specs and withPapyrus() must not run any check inside an Amplify build
description:
Repo: AnthusAI/Papyrus. Files: `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.ts`, `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.test.ts` (or sibling tests), `packages/papyrus/src/with-papyrus.mjs`, `features/` (Gherkin), `docs/site-hosting.md`, repo-root `amplify.yml`.

Steps:
1. Land/verify the in-flight `withPapyrus()` change: when `AWS_APP_ID` (Amplify) is set, Next config gets `eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds = true` and `typescript.ignoreBuildErrors = true`. Outside Amplify (Actions, local) checks stay on. Unit test both branches.
2. Audit `cmsProductionBuildSpec`, `cmsStagingBuildSpec`, `readerBuildSpec`: the only allowed commands are install (`npm ci --cache .npm --prefer-offline`), `ampx pipeline-deploy` / `generate outputs`, `papyrus-app sync`, `npm run build`, content export/upload, and the outputs copy. Add a test that fails if any generated spec contains `test`, `lint`, `tsc`, `typecheck`, `behave`, `pytest`, `unittest`.
3. Repo-root `amplify.yml` in Papyrus deploys legacy apps only (not in papyrus-production). Either delete it (preferred, after confirming no live app uses the Papyrus repo: `aws amplify list-apps` in legacy shows repo=Papyrus apps with auto-build now off) or make it deploy-only too. Record which in docs/site-hosting.md.
4. Gherkin: `features/amplify-deploy-only.feature`: "Given a site built inside Amplify, when the build runs, then no lint, type-check or test command runs and the build still fails on a compile error" (Next's compile still catches syntax errors).
5. Document in docs/site-hosting.md: "Amplify deploys; CI runs in Actions (public) or locally with a LeftBlock receipt (private)".

Acceptance: build-spec tests pass; `npm run typecheck && npm run lint` locally; generated specs contain no check commands; PR → CI → merge to develop; released in the next Papyrus version (sites pick it up with the bump in the next story).
